name: Annaleigh Chan

text.ability: Once a round, at the colony, Annaleigh looks at one random card from another player's hand. Not used in the co-op variant.
text.bio: Argues for a living and never takes a word at face value.

notes: src: survivors-sources.md row 3 (C10): ability location and target follow the Portuguese fan card (colony, one random card from one other hand); the wiki says anywhere, every other hand. Removed in the co-op variant (W, T).
